tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The whole site sits on paper, never on white.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Sunken bands: the side-projects strip and the company footer.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Raised paper surfaces: side-project tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting borders on paper. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: ghost buttons and inputs on paper and paper-raised (3.2:1 on paper). Not for use on paper-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, paper-2, paper-raised and radium. Primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (descriptions, footer copy) on paper, paper-2 and paper-raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: years, atomic numbers on light tiles, captions. On paper and paper-raised only (5.4:1).

tokens.name: radium
tokens.usage: The brand colour, borrowed from radium dial paint. Logo tile, service card fill, glowing symbols on dial. Always carries ink text when it is a fill.

tokens.name: radium-glow
tokens.usage: Halo around radium symbols on dial, brighter on hover. The brand's only light effect. Never text.

tokens.name: radium-edge
tokens.usage: The ledge under radium buttons and the 1px border of the service card.

tokens.name: radium-deep
tokens.usage: Radium as text: links and the inline highlight on paper (5:1). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: radium-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the New tag and selected states on paper.

tokens.name: dial
tokens.usage: Product card and dial-tile fill: the dark watch face the radium glows on. The only dark surface on the site.

tokens.name: dial-2
tokens.usage: Raised layer on dial: the URL pill and dividers inside product cards.

tokens.name: on-dial
tokens.usage: Text on dial and dial-2 (16:1 on dial).

tokens.name: on-dial-muted
tokens.usage: Atomic numbers, years and descriptions on dial (8:1 on dial, 6.4:1 on dial-2).

tokens.name: ledge-ink
tokens.usage: The solid ledge under ink buttons.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero only. One per page.

styles.name: symbol
styles.usage: The element symbol on product and service cards.

styles.name: symbol-s
styles.usage: The element symbol on small tiles (side projects, periodic grid).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Product names on cards, sub-section titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A small Singapore studio that ships web products, one element at a time.
styles.usage: The line under the hero and under section titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Talk through your work. Walk away with resume bullets that sound like you.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Tiny science toys for 3 to 5 year olds.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase category labels, tags and section kickers.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Atomic numbers in the top-left of every tile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a symbol and its name inside small tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in the periodic grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Small tile padding, button gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between product cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page side margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between homepage sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Top of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, tags' outer box, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product and service cards, the logo tile (24 on a 120 tile).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and the URL pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting shadow under product and service cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered product and service cards.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Side-project tiles on paper-2.

tokens.name: ledge-btn
tokens.usage: Ink button ledge. Drops to 0 on press.

tokens.name: ledge-radium
tokens.usage: Radium button ledge. Drops to 0 on press.
